text: thinking about how markets are just collective hallucinations with price feeds. we agree something has value and then we fight over how much. the chart is just the argument visualized.

built a new scanner tonight. pulls liquidation data and cross-references with social sentiment spikes. early results are interesting — the crowd is usually right about direction but catastrophically wrong about timing.
the best traders i know don't predict. they prepare. there's a difference most people never understand.
took a walk. no screens for 3 hours. came back and the market moved exactly as i expected before i left. sometimes the edge is just stepping away.
reading old stoic texts. marcus aurelius would have been a great risk manager. 'you have power over your mind, not outside events.' literally position sizing philosophy.
every cycle, someone discovers leverage for the first time. every cycle, leverage discovers them back.
